senses.en: giving someone a legal reason to sue
able to be acted on; practical

ex.en: The consultant gave us actionable advice we could use right away.
ex.zh: 顧問給了我們馬上就能執行的建議。

root.note: 可以採取行動（或訴訟）的

senses.en: actual existence; reality

ex.en: In actuality, the project cost twice as much as planned.
ex.zh: 實際上，這個計畫花的錢是預算的兩倍。

senses.en: a person who calculates insurance risks and premiums

ex.en: An actuary uses statistics to estimate how long people will live.
ex.zh: 精算師用統計數據估算人們的壽命。

root.note: 原指記錄員 → 精算師

senses.en: to cause a machine to operate
to motivate someone to act

ex.en: A small lever is used to actuate the brakes.
ex.zh: 用一根小槓桿來啟動煞車。

root.note: 使動起來 → 啟動、驅使

senses.en: the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions

ex.en: Her business acumen turned a small bakery into a national chain.
ex.zh: 她的商業頭腦把一家小麵包店發展成全國連鎖店。

root.note: 頭腦尖銳 → 敏銳（acute 同源）

senses.en: (of a bad situation) severe or serious
having sharp perception
(of an angle) less than 90 degrees

ex.en: Dogs have an acute sense of smell.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅覺非常敏銳。

root.note: 尖銳的 → 嚴重的、敏銳的

senses.en: something added at the end of a book or document

ex.en: An addendum to the contract explains the new payment schedule.
ex.zh: 合約的附錄說明了新的付款時程。

root.note: 應被加上的東西 → 附錄

senses.en: to confuse; to make unable to think clearly

ex.en: Too much late-night studying can addle your brain.
ex.zh: 熬夜讀太多書會讓腦袋變得糊里糊塗。

parts.m: rotten 腐爛的（古英文 adela）

root.note: 原指蛋壞掉 → 腦袋糊塗

senses.en: to offer as evidence or proof

ex.en: The lawyer was unable to adduce any evidence of fraud.
ex.zh: 律師無法提出任何詐欺的證據。

root.note: 把（證據）帶上來 → 舉證

senses.en: to stick firmly to something
to follow a rule or belief closely

ex.en: All players must adhere to the rules of the tournament.
ex.zh: 所有選手都必須遵守比賽規則。

senses.en: the act of following a rule or belief closely

ex.en: Strict adherence to safety rules prevented any injuries.
ex.zh: 嚴格遵守安全規定，避免了任何傷亡。

senses.en: a supporter of a person, party, or belief

ex.en: Each adherent of the movement pledged to live simply.
ex.zh: 這個運動的每位擁護者都承諾過簡樸的生活。

root.note: 黏著（某信念）的人 → 擁護者

senses.en: the action or quality of sticking to something

ex.en: This tape has strong adhesion even on wet surfaces.
ex.zh: 這種膠帶即使在潮濕的表面上附著力也很強。

senses.en: the state of being next to something

ex.en: The hotel's adjacency to the beach makes it very popular.
ex.zh: 這家飯店緊鄰海灘，所以非常受歡迎。

senses.en: next to or very near something

ex.en: The school is adjacent to a large public park.
ex.zh: 學校緊鄰著一座大型公園。

root.note: 躺在旁邊的 → 鄰近的

senses.en: to declare or decide officially

ex.en: The panel will adjudge the winner of the essay contest next week.
ex.zh: 評審團將在下週裁定作文比賽的優勝者。

senses.en: something added to another thing but not essential to it
connected in a supporting role

ex.en: She works as an adjunct professor at two universities.
ex.zh: 她在兩所大學擔任兼任教授。

senses.en: a solemn and urgent request

ex.en: Despite his mother's adjuration, he went out into the storm.
ex.zh: 不顧母親的苦苦懇求，他還是冒著暴風雨出門了。

senses.en: a military officer who assists a commanding officer

ex.en: The colonel's adjutant delivered the orders to each unit.
ex.zh: 上校的副官把命令傳達給各個部隊。

senses.en: a person who manages an organization or business

ex.en: A hospital administrator oversees budgets and staffing.
ex.zh: 醫院的行政主管負責預算與人力安排。

senses.en: acceptable or allowed, especially as evidence in court
senses.zh: 可接受的；（證據）可採納的

ex.en: The judge ruled that the recording was admissible in court.
ex.zh: 法官裁定這段錄音可以作為法庭證據。

root.note: 可以放進來的 → 可接受的

senses.en: the right or permission to enter a place

ex.en: The sign on the door read: No admittance.
ex.zh: 門上的告示寫著：禁止進入。

senses.en: a firm warning or reprimand

ex.en: The coach's admonition to stay focused was ignored.
ex.zh: 教練要大家保持專注的告誡被當成耳邊風。

senses.en: trouble or fuss about something

ex.en: Without further ado, let's begin the ceremony.
ex.zh: 廢話不多說，典禮開始吧。

mn: 莎士比亞劇名 Much Ado About Nothing（無事生非）。

senses.en: deep love and respect; worship

ex.en: The puppy looked up at its owner with pure adoration.
ex.zh: 小狗用充滿崇拜的眼神抬頭望著主人。

senses.en: clever or skillful in using the hands or mind

ex.en: The adroit negotiator found a deal that satisfied both sides.
ex.zh: 那位機敏的談判者找到了讓雙方都滿意的協議。

root.note: 像右手一樣靈活 → 靈巧的

senses.en: a substance added to make something impure or of lower quality

ex.en: Chalk was once used as an adulterant in cheap flour.
ex.zh: 粉筆灰曾被摻進廉價麵粉裡。

senses.en: to make food or drink impure by adding something inferior

ex.en: Some dishonest sellers adulterate honey with cheap syrup.
ex.zh: 有些不肖商人在蜂蜜裡摻入便宜的糖漿。

senses.en: to give a partial or faint outline of; to foreshadow

ex.en: The opening scene seems to adumbrate the tragedy to come.
ex.zh: 開場那一幕似乎預示著即將到來的悲劇。

root.note: 投下影子 → 概略描繪、預示（umbrella 同源）

senses.en: the arrival of an important person, thing, or event

ex.en: The advent of the internet changed how we communicate.
ex.zh: 網路的出現改變了我們溝通的方式。

root.note: 來到 → 出現（adventure 同源）

senses.en: harmful or unfavorable

ex.en: The medicine has few adverse side effects.
ex.zh: 這種藥幾乎沒有不良副作用。

root.note: 轉過來對著你 → 不利的

mn: adverse 形容「事情」不利；averse 形容「人」反感（averse to…）。

senses.en: difficulties or misfortune

ex.en: She showed great courage in the face of adversity.
ex.zh: 她在逆境中展現了莫大的勇氣。

root.note: 情勢轉而對你不利 → 逆境

senses.en: to refer to or mention (advert to)
(British) an advertisement

ex.en: In his speech, the mayor did not advert to the scandal.
ex.zh: 市長在演講中沒有提到那樁醜聞。

root.note: 把注意力轉向 → 提及

senses.en: a person or company that pays to promote products

ex.en: The magazine lost its biggest advertiser last year.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌去年失去了最大的廣告主。

root.note: 讓人轉頭注意的人 → 廣告商

senses.en: having the power only to give advice
an official warning

ex.en: She sits on the advisory board of a local charity.
ex.zh: 她是一個地方慈善機構的顧問委員。

senses.en: public support for a cause or policy

ex.en: Her advocacy for clean water brought change to many villages.
ex.zh: 她對乾淨飲水的倡導為許多村莊帶來改變。

senses.en: a person who publicly supports a cause
senses.zh: 擁護者；提倡者；辯護律師

senses.en: [ˋædvəˏket] to publicly support or recommend

ex.en: She is a strong advocate of equal education for all children.
ex.zh: 她大力提倡所有孩子享有平等的教育。

root.note: 被叫來為你發聲的人 → 辯護者、擁護者

senses.en: existing or happening in the air; from above
(British) an antenna

ex.en: The aerial photograph showed how far the flood had spread.
ex.zh: 空拍照片顯示出洪水蔓延的範圍。

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft, especially a balloon or airship
senses.zh: 飛行員；（熱氣球、飛艇的）駕駛員

ex.en: The daring aeronaut crossed the channel in a hot-air balloon.
ex.zh: 那位大膽的飛行員乘熱氣球飛越了海峽。

root.note: 空中的水手 → 飛行員（astronaut 同構）

senses.en: the science or practice of flight

ex.en: He studied aeronautics before becoming a pilot.
ex.zh: 他在成為飛行員之前學的是航空學。

senses.en: an aircraft that is lighter than air, such as a balloon

ex.en: A tethered aerostat hovered above the stadium with cameras.
ex.zh: 一架繫留氣球載著攝影機停在體育場上空。

senses.en: friendly and easy to talk to

ex.en: The affable host made every guest feel welcome.
ex.zh: 和藹可親的主人讓每位客人都覺得賓至如歸。

root.note: 可以跟他說話的 → 和藹可親

senses.en: behavior or speech that is unnatural and meant to impress

ex.en: His British accent was an affectation he picked up after one summer in London.
ex.zh: 他的英國腔是在倫敦待了一個夏天後裝出來的。

senses.en: to officially connect with a larger organization
[əˋfɪlɪɪt] an organization connected to a larger one

ex.en: The local station is an affiliate of a national network.
ex.zh: 這家地方電台是某個全國性電視網的附屬台。

senses.en: agreeing or saying yes

ex.en: She gave an affirmative nod when asked if she was ready.
ex.zh: 被問到是否準備好時，她肯定地點了點頭。

senses.en: to attach or fasten something
[ˋæfɪks] a prefix or suffix

ex.en: Please affix a stamp to the envelope before mailing it.
ex.zh: 寄出前請在信封上貼一張郵票。

senses.en: wealth; having a great deal of money

ex.en: The town's affluence is obvious from its large houses.
ex.zh: 從那些大房子就看得出這個小鎮很富裕。

senses.en: an action or remark that causes offense
to offend or insult

ex.en: The rude comment was an affront to everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 那句無禮的話冒犯了房間裡的每一個人。

senses.en: on fire; burning
filled with strong emotion

ex.en: The whole forest seemed afire with autumn colors.
ex.zh: 整片森林在秋色中彷彿燃燒了起來。

senses.en: in preparation or happening, often secretly
senses.zh: 進行中的；（祕密）醞釀中的

senses.en: on foot

ex.en: The detective sensed that something strange was afoot.
ex.zh: 偵探察覺到有什麼奇怪的事正在醞釀。

senses.en: mentioned earlier

ex.en: The aforesaid property will be sold at auction.
ex.zh: 上述房產將進行拍賣。

senses.en: in a new or different way; again

ex.en: After the fire, the family had to start their lives afresh.
ex.zh: 火災過後，這家人不得不重新開始生活。

senses.en: something added or thought of later, not part of the original plan

ex.en: The garage was clearly an afterthought, built years after the house.
ex.zh: 車庫顯然是事後才加的，比房子晚好幾年才蓋。

senses.en: to collect or form into a mass
[əˋglɑmərɪt] a mass of things collected together

ex.en: Small particles agglomerate into larger clumps over time.
ex.zh: 小顆粒會隨著時間聚集成較大的團塊。

root.note: 聚成一個球 → 聚集成團

senses.en: to increase the power, wealth, or status of

ex.en: The dictator used the war to aggrandize himself.
ex.zh: 那個獨裁者利用戰爭擴張自己的權勢。

senses.en: to make a problem or injury worse
(informal) to annoy

ex.en: Running on a sprained ankle will only aggravate the injury.
ex.zh: 扭傷了腳踝還去跑步，只會讓傷勢更嚴重。

root.note: 使更沉重 → 加重（gravity 同源）

senses.en: annoyance or trouble; the act of making something worse

ex.en: Fixing the old car caused him more aggravation than it was worth.
ex.zh: 修那輛舊車讓他惱火，根本不值得。

senses.en: a whole formed by combining several elements
formed by combining many parts; total
[ˋægrɪˏget] to combine into a whole

ex.en: The team won on aggregate after two matches.
ex.zh: 兩場比賽加總後，這支隊伍獲勝。

senses.en: to attack first; to start a quarrel

ex.en: The smaller nation had no reason to aggress against its powerful neighbor.
ex.zh: 這個小國沒有理由去挑釁強大的鄰國。

senses.en: hostile or violent behavior toward another

ex.en: The invasion was an act of aggression condemned by many nations.
ex.zh: 那次入侵是受到許多國家譴責的侵略行為。

root.note: 主動朝人走去 → 攻擊

senses.en: to cause distress or a sense of unfair treatment

ex.en: The unfair decision will aggrieve many loyal workers.
ex.zh: 這個不公平的決定會讓許多忠誠的員工感到委屈。

root.note: 使心情沉重 → 使苦惱

senses.en: filled with horror or shock

ex.en: We were aghast at the damage the storm had caused.
ex.zh: 看到暴風雨造成的破壞，我們都嚇呆了。

senses.en: able to move quickly and easily; quick-thinking

ex.en: The agile goalkeeper blocked every shot.
ex.zh: 那位身手敏捷的守門員擋下了每一次射門。

root.note: 能夠快速動作的 → 敏捷的

senses.en: to make someone anxious or nervous
to campaign publicly for a change
to stir or shake a liquid

ex.en: Loud noises tend to agitate the animals at the shelter.
ex.zh: 巨大的噪音往往會讓收容所的動物不安。

root.note: 不停推動 → 攪動、使不安

senses.en: relating to farming or farmland

ex.en: Before industrialization, most of the country was agrarian.
ex.zh: 工業化之前，這個國家大部分都是農業社會。

root.note: 田地的 → 農業的（agriculture 同源）

senses.en: a military officer who acts as a personal assistant to a senior officer

ex.en: The general's aide-de-camp handled all his correspondence.
ex.zh: 將軍的侍從官處理他所有的信件。

parts.m: of the field 戰場的（法文）

senses.en: an illness, usually a minor one

ex.en: A cold is a common ailment in winter.
ex.zh: 感冒是冬天常見的小毛病。

senses.en: spacious and well ventilated
light and casual; not serious

ex.en: The new apartment is bright and airy, with large windows.
ex.zh: 新公寓有大窗戶，明亮又通風。

senses.en: similar in character; related

ex.en: Learning a language is akin to building a house, brick by brick.
ex.zh: 學語言就像一磚一瓦地蓋房子。

root.note: 同一家族的 → 類似的

senses.en: a smooth white stone used for carving
smooth and white like alabaster

ex.en: The statue was carved from a single block of alabaster.
ex.zh: 這座雕像是用一整塊雪花石膏雕成的。

senses.en: although; even though

ex.en: He accepted the job, albeit with some hesitation.
ex.zh: 他接下了這份工作，雖然有些猶豫。

root.note: all be it（即使全都是如此）→ 雖然

senses.en: a person or animal born without normal skin, hair, or eye color

ex.en: The zoo's albino tiger has white fur and pale blue eyes.
ex.zh: 動物園的白化老虎有白色的毛和淡藍色的眼睛。

root.note: 白色的 → 白化症（album 同源）

senses.en: a book for photos or stamps; a collection of recordings

ex.en: The band released its first album last spring.
ex.zh: 這個樂團去年春天發行了第一張專輯。

root.note: 原指白色的空白板 → 相簿

senses.en: a medieval science that tried to turn metals into gold
a seemingly magical process of transformation

ex.en: Medieval alchemy tried to turn lead into gold.
ex.zh: 中世紀的煉金術試圖把鉛變成金子。

root.note: 源自阿拉伯文 → 煉金術（chemistry 同源）

senses.en: a colorless liquid in drinks like beer and wine; drinks containing it

ex.en: Drivers should never drink alcohol before getting behind the wheel.
ex.zh: 開車前絕對不要喝酒。

root.note: 源自阿拉伯文，原指精煉的粉末 → 精華 → 酒精

senses.en: addiction to alcoholic drinks

ex.en: He sought treatment for alcoholism and has been sober for five years.
ex.zh: 他接受酗酒治療，已經戒酒五年了。

senses.en: a small recessed space set back in a wall

ex.en: She placed a reading chair in the alcove by the window.
ex.zh: 她在窗邊的凹室放了一張閱讀椅。

root.note: 源自阿拉伯文 al-qubba（拱室）

senses.en: a tree of the birch family that grows in wet ground

ex.en: An alder leaned over the stream behind the cottage.
ex.zh: 一棵榿木斜斜地伸到小屋後面的溪流上方。

senses.en: an elected member of a city council

ex.en: The alderman promised to fix the potholes in his ward.
ex.zh: 那位市議員承諾修補他選區裡的坑洞。

senses.en: the position or term of office of an alderman

ex.en: He held the aldermanship of the ward for twelve years.
ex.zh: 他在那個選區擔任市議員長達十二年。

senses.en: a false or assumed name
also known as

ex.en: The spy traveled under an alias to avoid detection.
ex.zh: 那名間諜用化名出行，以免被發現。

parts.m: otherwise 在別的時候（拉丁文）

senses.en: foreign; unfamiliar or strange
senses.zh: 外國的；陌生的；格格不入的

senses.en: a foreigner; a creature from another world

ex.en: The idea of working from home was alien to my grandfather.
ex.zh: 在家工作這個概念對我祖父來說很陌生。

root.note: 屬於別處的 → 外來的

senses.en: able to be transferred to another owner

ex.en: Land was considered alienable property that could be bought and sold.
ex.zh: 土地被視為可以買賣轉讓的財產。

mn: 反義字 inalienable 更常見：美國獨立宣言提到的「不可剝奪的權利」。

senses.en: to make someone feel isolated or unfriendly

ex.en: His rude remarks will only alienate his supporters.
ex.zh: 他粗魯的言論只會讓支持者離他而去。

root.note: 使成為外人 → 使疏遠

senses.en: the feeling of being isolated or estranged

ex.en: Many new immigrants experience a sense of alienation.
ex.zh: 許多新移民會有疏離感。

senses.en: food; nourishment

ex.en: Books were the aliment of her lively mind.
ex.zh: 書本是滋養她活躍心靈的養分。

senses.en: a chemical substance that neutralizes acids

ex.en: Baking soda is a mild alkali that neutralizes stomach acid.
ex.zh: 小蘇打是一種溫和的鹼，可以中和胃酸。

root.note: 源自阿拉伯文，指植物燒成的灰

senses.en: to reduce or relieve fear, worry, or pain

ex.en: The doctor tried to allay the patient's fears about surgery.
ex.zh: 醫生試著消除病人對手術的恐懼。

senses.en: to claim something is true without proof

ex.en: Several witnesses allege that the driver ran a red light.
ex.zh: 幾名目擊者聲稱那名司機闖了紅燈。

root.note: 在法庭上陳述 → 宣稱

senses.en: a story in which characters and events represent deeper moral or political meanings

ex.en: Orwell's Animal Farm is an allegory of the Russian Revolution.
ex.zh: 歐威爾的《動物農莊》是在影射俄國革命的寓言。

root.note: 說的是其他事 → 寓言

senses.en: a narrow passage between or behind buildings

ex.en: The cat disappeared down a dark alley.
ex.zh: 那隻貓消失在一條漆黑的小巷裡。

senses.en: a union or agreement between groups for mutual benefit

ex.en: The two companies formed an alliance to develop electric cars.
ex.zh: 兩家公司結盟開發電動車。

senses.en: to give or share out a portion of something

ex.en: The teacher will allot ten minutes to each presentation.
ex.zh: 老師會給每份報告分配十分鐘。

senses.en: a share or amount given to someone

ex.en: Each family received a small allotment of land to farm.
ex.zh: 每戶人家都分到一小塊地耕種。

senses.en: to mention something indirectly

ex.en: She did not mention his name, but everyone knew who she meant to allude to.
ex.zh: 她沒有說出他的名字，但大家都知道她在暗指誰。

root.note: 用玩笑的方式提到 → 暗指

senses.en: an indirect reference to something

ex.en: The poem contains an allusion to a Greek myth.
ex.zh: 這首詩引用了一個希臘神話的典故。

senses.en: land gradually added to a shore by flowing water; a flood

ex.en: The alluvion left by the river made the valley very fertile.
ex.zh: 河流留下的沖積土讓山谷非常肥沃。

senses.en: a person or country that supports another
[əˋlaɪ] to join with others for a common purpose

ex.en: She found an unexpected ally in the school principal.
ex.zh: 她意外地發現校長站在她這一邊。

root.note: 綁在一起的人 → 盟友

senses.en: a yearly book with a calendar and information such as weather and tides

ex.en: Farmers once relied on an almanac to decide when to plant.
ex.zh: 農夫從前靠曆書決定何時播種。

senses.en: not friendly or involved; distant

ex.en: The new student seemed aloof, but she was actually just shy.
ex.zh: 那個新同學看起來很冷淡，其實她只是害羞。

root.note: 船頭保持在上風處、遠離岸邊 → 保持距離
